event_reasoning.rule: BUY only when point-in-time evidence supports a net crude-supply contraction expected to persist beyond 10 Chinese trading sessions after named mitigation and resolution evidence; otherwise ABSTAIN.

sentiment.rule: Apply the frozen supply-tone lexicon only to first_disclosure_text; BUY when disruption terms outnumber relief or expansion terms, otherwise ABSTAIN.

momentum.rule: Using only source-bound observations whose session close is no later than as_of, BUY when the last adjusted close is strictly above the adjusted close three open sessions earlier; otherwise ABSTAIN.

fixed_mapping.rule: BUY every cluster whose frozen primary_supply_direction is contraction, without considering persistence, mitigation, or resolution; otherwise ABSTAIN.

simple_hold.rule: BUY one lot for every registered cluster.

event_clusters.first_disclosure_text: United States participation ends and sanctions are reimposed.
event_clusters.decision_basis: The order began reimposing oil-related sanctions with a deadline up to 180 days, exceeding the longest evaluation horizon.

event_clusters.first_disclosure_text: Production suspension of 5.7 million barrels per day.
event_clusters.decision_basis: By the cutoff, Aramco reported rapid restoration, full capacity by month-end, inventory mitigation, and no missed customer shipment.

event_clusters.first_disclosure_text: Oil blockade and force majeure halted exports from eastern ports and onshore fields.
event_clusters.decision_basis: The Security Council record described force majeure across ports and fields with no resolution at the cutoff.

event_clusters.first_disclosure_text: No additional production adjustment was agreed while demand contracted and excess supply grew.
event_clusters.decision_basis: The available evidence combined an unadopted cut recommendation with a demand collapse and excess-supply risk, not a persistent net contraction.

event_clusters.first_disclosure_text: The canal was blocked by the grounded vessel and navigation returned at full capacity.
event_clusters.decision_basis: The evaluation begins only after the authority reported full-capacity navigation, so the physical interruption was resolved before entry.

event_clusters.first_disclosure_text: OPEC plus talks were called off and the supply deficit remained tight.
event_clusters.decision_basis: At the cutoff the meeting remained called off, July quotas remained in place, and the IEA described an unresolved supply deficit beyond ten sessions.

event_clusters.first_disclosure_text: Russia invasion created tight markets and a risk of supply shortfall.
event_clusters.decision_basis: The emergency stock release responded to already tight markets and an unresolved geopolitical supply risk expected beyond ten sessions.
